data.mechanism: Everolimus is rapamycin with a solubilising side chain - same FKBP12 mechanism, better oral pharmacokinetics. It is the molecule that carried this pathway into routine clinical use.
data.mechanism_beginner: Everolimus is rapamycin with a small chemical tweak that makes it easier to take as a pill – same mechanism, better drug.
data.note: Six trials behind one arrow. They establish the clinical effect of the drug; the allosteric mechanism itself rests on the rapamycin biochemistry.
